neighbours.label: opening quotation mark that begins a quoted sentence after a reporting verb, comma or colon (said, "…; it read: "…)
fire: The mayor paused for a moment and then said, "Nobody in this town will be left behind."
A handwritten note taped to the fridge read: "Please do not eat my sandwich."
As my grandmother always put it, "A stitch in time saves nine."
The 2011 audit report states: "Controls over cash handling were inadequate."
One teacher at the school told us, "The children have never been so eager to read."
The telegram from headquarters said simply: "Return to base at once."
Turning to the jury, the lawyer asked, "Would any of you have acted differently?"
An old proverb from the region says: "The river does not drink its own water."

notes: Card: ' “' x14, ' "' x10 after said / read / states; the - pole is the comma just before such a quote. Probe: 'read: "Closed' 0.99, 'said, "We' 0.48; scare quotes 0.06, quote-first 0.01, a quoted title 0.22.
